name: Baris Soybilgen
lede: I research forecasting: nowcasting GDP, inflation and unemployment from high-frequency data, and reading business cycles with machine learning. I also build the machine-learning and LLM systems that put models like these into production.
description: Economist and data scientist in Stockholm. Research on nowcasting, business cycles and forecasting; open-source code; posts on Turkish markets.

about.heading: An economist who ships the code behind the model.
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Data Scientist at Sambla Group in Stockholm. I lead customer-facing generative AI applications used by mobile app customers in three markets, and I build LLM tools on company data, customer-level revenue models and marketing mix models.

I started my career in Turkey, forecasting the economy at Betam. Next came Istanbul Bilgi University, where as an assistant professor I taught and built deep-learning and statistical models for macro-finance forecasting and high-frequency indicators of the Turkish economy. I then moved to Sweden, where I analysed survey data at the Governance and Local Development Institute in Gothenburg before joining Sambla Group.
